name: What common issues are found in foreclosed homes that require renovation?

mainEntity.name: What common issues are found in foreclosed homes that require renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Foreclosed homes often present a range of common issues stemming from prolonged vacancy or neglect. These can include water damage, mold growth, pest infestations, outdated electrical systems, leaky plumbing, damaged roofs, and foundation problems. Additionally, previous occupants might have caused intentional damage or removed fixtures. A thorough inspection is crucial to uncover all hidden issues before renovation begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common issues in foreclosed homes include water damage, mold, pests, outdated systems, and structural problems due to neglect or previous damage.
